author: fujipullz
title: WRONGFUL SUSPENSION
content:
I had a really bad experience with CrownCards. I was actively using the platform and making transactions, then my account was suddenly suspended without a clear explanation. I also have $80 that I withdrew that I still have not received back. I’ve tried contacting support to get this resolved, but I feel like I’m being ignored.

The biggest issue is that I trusted this platform with my money, and now I’m having to dispute transactions with my bank just to try to recover funds that should have been returned to me. If you use this app, be extremely careful about putting money into it. I just want my $80 back and an actual explanation for why my account was suspended.

author: LintyKnight
